thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: PD-82347 - RATE_LIMITER_THROTTLE spikes detected in region-us-west, page fired :rotating_light:

maria: Acked and taking. Oncall is me.

kevin: I'm up, will start digging. Any metrics link?

incident-bot: graph: https://metrics.internal.redwood/graph?m=rate_limiter.429s.p50&env=prod

sanjay: seeing 429 spike from limiter-service. Affected tenants: tenant_42, tenant_7, tenant_alpha. Orders of magnitude - 5xx not spiking.

kevin: logs show limiter returning `RATE_LIMITED` due to quota-map returning 0 capacity for some tokens. Sample log:
```
2026-03-15T10:12:00Z limiter svc=limiter-1 tenant=tenant_42 token=abc123 result=THROTTLED quota_key="opaque:123" mapped_capacity=0
```

elaine: we pushed quota-mapper v2.3.1 ~9m ago. Could be mapping bug.

maria: timeline lines up. Rollout is 100% in us-west. Can we rollback the mapper? :grimacing: 

sanjay: I can pin to v2.2.8 via k8s. Command:
```
kubectl -n infra set image deployment/quota-mapper quota-mapper=registry.redwood/quota-mapper:v2.2.8
```

kevin: before rolling back, can we disable enforcement to stop customer impact? Toggle flag `quota.enforce=true/false` in config-service.

maria: Good call. Doing safe toggle to false for affected region only.

maria: `curl -X POST https://config.internal.redwood/flags -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" -d '{"quota.enforce":false, "regions":["us-west"]}'`

incident-bot: Flag change accepted, propagation to edge services started.

kevin: Propagation seen, 5 minutes for caches to expire. Meanwhile I'm starting rollback of quota-mapper to v2.2.8.

sanjay: rollback applied. Pods cycling.

kevin: New pods healthy. Metrics: 429s dropping back to baseline in 3m. https://metrics.internal.redwood/graph?m=rate_limiter.429s.p50&env=prod

elaine: Confirmed with logs: mapping returning proper capacities now.

maria: Re-enabled enforcement for us-west slowly: `quota.enforce=true` for control group -> monitor.

maria: enforcement reenabled, no new spikes. Customer impact window ~10m (10:12-10:22 UTC). Affected: 3 tenants, degraded responses (429) for short period.

kevin: Filing PD follow-up: will annotate incident on PD and point to rollback + flag toggle as mitigation. Assign owner: @sanjay for root cause and postmortem.

sanjay: on it. Initial hypothesis: mapper v2.3.1 has a regression where opaque IDs map to zero capacity under high fanout.

elaine: We'll capture canary tests to catch this next time, add validation in pre-deploy that ensures no zero-capacity mappings for live tenants.

maria: Who owns customer comms? We need to notify the three tenants ops and CS.

kevin: I'll draft a short note, include timeline, mitigation, and ETA for RCA (tomorrow EOD).

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-82347 acknowledged by maria. Escalation stopped.

maria: closing on slack thread. Will post follow-up with links: PR that caused change, rollback diff, metrics snapshots.

kevin: thumbs: :thumbsup: 

sanjay: adding to incident board and scheduling postmortem. ETA 48h.

incident-bot: Incident thread closed in channel incidents. For full timeline see: https://incidents.redwood/internal/PD-82347
